axes.axis: Windows API availability and compile compatibility
evidence: Independently fetched and Git/SHA256-verified the complete windows-sys 0.52.0 FileSystem, Authorization, Foundation and Security sources.
Candidate argument types match the exact declarations; FILE_STANDARD_INFO is exact-sized, and the existing Cargo cfg(windows) features enable these modules.
New tests are attached to the existing Windows unit module. The existing src/**/*.rs Bazel registration can discover these source files; actual Windows compilation remains required.
limits: No Windows compiler, linker, formatter or native test was run by this reviewer.
Platform/filesystem failures from FileStandardInfo or ReOpenFile propagate rather than being accepted as no-op.

axes.axis: Handle rights, same-object identity and resource ownership
evidence: Production opens READ_CONTROL with shared read/write/delete, queries type and DACL on that retained handle, and returns false before requesting WRITE_DAC when complete.

Incomplete repair obtains a new handle using ReOpenFile(original_handle, WRITE_DAC, same sharing, BACKUP_SEMANTICS), then sets DACL through that handle. No second pathname lookup selects the mutation object.
OwnedHandle and LocalAllocation retain and release each native resource; actual OS failures remain errors.

Matrix retains noninheritable share-delete handles with FILE_GENERIC_READ|WRITE_DAC, explicitly no DELETE. Before closing them it verifies object ID, DACL bytes, original file data and DeletePending/link information; after close it requires original identity or real NotFound.
The no-op control first proves OWNER_RIGHTS prevents the actual WRITE_DAC ReOpenFile, then requires false/false and unchanged DACL.
limits: Same-object binding does not serialize independent DACL writers, make the pathname/ancestor immutable, or guarantee correctness under an external concurrent ACL editor.
BACKUP_SEMANTICS does not enable a privilege; already enabled native backup/restore privileges still follow Windows rules. No new privilege enablement is added.
Normal fixture cleanup propagates restore failures. Best-effort unwind cleanup alone is not acceptance evidence.

evidence: Original single-ACE recursive query remains byte-identical. Only the private repair decision recognizes normalized representation.
File requires the same SID and an independently complete effective deny. Directory requires independently complete effective flags0 and recursive inherit-only flags0x0b denies for the same SID.

Only leading explicit deny entries can satisfy the new path. Wrong SID, partial masks, inherited/no-propagate/one-direction inheritance and allow-before-deny cannot falsely complete it. Generic masks are mapped using the same file generic mapping.
No combination of two individually partial masks is accepted; original deny masks/inheritance/setter error handling remain.
limits: This fixes recognition/idempotency of a complete stored ACL representation. It does not prove that WRITE_RESTRICTED enforces DELETE or parent DELETE_CHILD.

axes.axis: Original failure assertions and meaningful physical controls
evidence: All original acl_tests.rs bytes are a prefix of the candidate; all original token_tests.rs bytes are a prefix of the candidate.
Removing only the new test module registration exactly restores original unified_exec/tests.rs and lib.rs.
The three strict original failure definitions remain entirely unchanged, including expected PermissionDenied, no-write/no-delete and legacy outside/.git assertions.
New token control uses unchanged create_workspace_write_token_with_caps_from and asserts restricting SID membership exactly [true,true,false,false] for cap_a/cap_b/logon/Everyone.

Everyone appears only in protected test-object DACLs, not as a restored restricting capability. Ordinary host four-cell results must be [deny,delete,delete,delete] before restricted conclusions; restricted results require all denied and physically retained.

Legacy control uses actual host cmd and unchanged production legacy spawn path, verifies all four attempt markers plus completion, writable-root deletion positive, then actual outside file/directory state. Command exit code alone never proves deletion enforcement.
limits: No skipped/error case can count as permission proof. These new controls are expected to expose the remaining deletion weakness if it persists.
No Windows deletion mitigation is introduced by the matrix itself; the original three remain blocking until original-platform evidence exists.

reconstruction.scope: Real local Git apply --check/apply against a partial tree of exact source preimages; not a full product build.

integration_notes: Apply only the exact manifest paths. The matrix candidate directory also contains a superseded V1 helper named delete_permission_matrix.rs; it is not in the V2 patch, not registered, and must not be copied as a directory payload.
The idempotency patch is a conventional unified diff; its /dev/null new file was successfully applied by Git as-is. No candidate patch-format change is required.
Four exact reconstruction sequences passed: idempotency; matrix combined; matrix token then legacy; idempotency plus matrix. The 8 unique source paths do not overlap.

The first local review script completed its patch work but erred while locating the next function for preservation checks. That reviewer-script error is recorded, corrected, and not presented as a candidate failure.

requirements: Run the unchanged original hosted target/filters/budgets and preserve every original strict case.
Capture exact source/tree, real compiled libtest roster, complete test.log/XML/attempts, and whether each target was cached.
All three new ACL controls and both physical matrix controls require actual execution; no early error, no-op, zero selected test, or target-only summary may replace their endpoints.
Do not declare deletion repaired if only idempotency succeeds; original strict deletion assertions must succeed under the production token/legacy path.
